offering_description.value: Lindblad sells small-ship expedition cruises and guided land tours to leisure travelers. It operates expedition ships with onboard naturalists and organizes land trips such as wildlife safaris, walking tours, and cycling vacations.

primary_services.value: small-ship expedition cruises; wildlife tours and safaris; guided walking and cultural tours; cycling tours; family adventure trips

customer_segment.value: B2C: Leisure travelers, including wildlife enthusiasts, active travelers, and families

end_markets.value: expedition cruising; wildlife and nature tourism; active travel; cultural tourism; family adventure travel

revenue_model.value: service fees: Cruise fares and tour package prices covering lodging, transportation, and guided activities

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Uses expedition ships, crews, and onboard naturalists to deliver voyages to leisure travelers; service provider: Combines local guides, lodging, and transportation into land tours for leisure travelers

geography_served.value: global: Antarctica, the Arctic, North America, Latin America, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Oceania

specialization.value: related lines: Expedition cruises, wildlife safaris, walking and cultural tours, cycling trips, and family adventures

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house travel specialists and telephone reservations; agents / brokers: Independent travel advisors and agencies; online: Company-operated cruise and tour booking websites; partners / resellers: National Geographic co-marketing for expedition cruises
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; online; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Passenger vessels require flag-state certification and must meet maritime safety and environmental rules, including the IMO Polar Code where applicable.
